data.value: Persistent worlds, Workshop mods, our own hardware.

data.value: Dedicated Project Zomboid servers with Build 41 and 42, a Workshop Manager that resolves mod IDs for you, backups, console and file access, and a deploy that runs from payment to a running world without a ticket.

data.value: Console, files and backups in the HTS panel

data.name: Zomboid.MetaDescription
data.value: Project Zomboid servers from 4 to 16 GB on hardware we own. Workshop Manager, backups, console, files, and an automated deploy. Monthly, quarterly or annual billing.

data.name: Zomboid.Title
data.value: Your world. Your Project Zomboid server

data.name: Zomboid.Lede
data.value: Choose the resources your community needs. Workshop mods, console, and file access come with every plan, managed through the HTS control panel.

data.name: Zomboid.ProductDetail
data.value: A persistent world, your Workshop mods, and one panel to manage the server.

data.name: Zomboid.FeatureTitle
data.value: The same platform on every tier

data.name: Zomboid.Feature.Build42Detail
data.value: Switch the build from the panel. The world stays where it is.

data.name: Zomboid.Feature.WorkshopDetail
data.value: Search the Workshop from the panel or add by ID; mod IDs are resolved for you.

data.name: Zomboid.Feature.ManagerDetail
data.value: Add, order and remove mods without editing the ini by hand.

data.name: Zomboid.Feature.BackupsDetail

data.name: Zomboid.Feature.ConsoleDetail

data.name: Zomboid.Feature.FilesDetail
data.value: Edit configuration and read logs in the browser, or over SFTP.

data.name: Zomboid.Feature.ResourcesDetail
data.value: Memory, CPU allocation and storage are the plan. Move up when the world grows.

data.name: Zomboid.Feature.PanelDetail
data.value: Start, stop, restart, schedule, and see resource use - one panel for the server.

data.name: Zomboid.Feature.DeployDetail
data.value: Paid to online without a ticket: the platform provisions the server itself.

data.name: Trial.Title
data.value: Your world. Your server. Try it for 24 hours

data.name: Trial.Body
data.value: Create a Project Zomboid or Minecraft trial on HTS. Verify your email, explore the panel and keep the same world when you choose a plan.

data.name: Trial.Note
data.value: One trial per account · no card required

data.name: Picker.Title
data.value: The right resources for your world

data.name: Picker.Lede
data.value: {2} plans, from {0} to {1} GB RAM. Compare the resources and choose monthly, quarterly, or annual billing.

data.name: Picker.TotalNote
data.value: The displayed price is the total for the selected billing period.

data.name: Picker.ReviewNote
data.value: Next, review your server configuration and the total amount before proceeding to payment.

data.name: Review.Lede
data.value: Check the configuration and the total. Payment is the next step, on Stripe.

data.name: Review.RenewsMonthly
data.value: Renews every month at the same amount.

data.name: Review.Renews
data.value: Renews every {0} months at the same amount.

data.name: Review.StripeNote
data.value: Payment is handled by Stripe on its own secure page. The total above is the amount the server sends to Stripe.

data.name: Review.NotConfigured
data.value: Payments are not switched on for this deployment yet. Your configuration is saved on this page - write to us and we will set the server up by hand.

data.name: Review.Failed
data.value: Stripe could not start the payment. Nothing was charged. Try again in a moment.

data.name: Review.Rejected
data.value: That plan and period could not be priced. Choose again from the plans.

data.name: Review.NotFound.Body
data.value: The link is missing a plan, or the plan is not on sale. Choose a plan and try again.

data.name: Success.LedeWaiting
data.value: Stripe is telling us about your payment. This page updates itself; it usually takes a few seconds.

data.name: Success.LedePaid
data.value: The platform is creating the server on one of our nodes. Keep this page open or come back to it; the order reference below is yours.

data.name: Success.LedeActive
data.value: Sign in to the panel to open the console, add mods and share the address with your players.

data.name: Success.LedeFailed
data.value: Payment went through, but provisioning did not finish on its own. We have the order and will set the server up by hand. Write to us if you want to move faster.

data.name: Success.LedeUnknown
data.value: We could not find an order for this session. If you were charged, write to us with the time of the payment.

data.name: Cancel.Lede
data.value: Nothing was charged. Your configuration is kept on this page - pick it up where you left it, or change the billing period.

data.name: Cancel.NotFound
data.value: We could not find that order. Choose a plan to start again.

data.name: Trial.Page.Lede
data.value: Play for {0} hours on HTS infrastructure. After the trial, your server is suspended and your world is kept for {1} days so you can choose a plan.

data.name: Trial.Step.Keep

data.name: Trial.Unavailable
